svg.aria-label: OpenMasjid Companion showing a masjid's prayer timetable on a phone

g.text: Scan the QR code on the noticeboard.
Add it to the home screen. That’s it.
Your timetable, straight from OpenMasjid Display
A countdown to the next Iqamah, with Jumu‘ah and the Hijri date
Prayer reminders and announcements, chosen per phone
A Qibla compass, and your appeals from OpenMasjid Donations
Works with no signal, and says when it last updated
Never calculates a prayer time. Never handles money.
A real masjid’s own timetable, read from their OpenMasjid Display.
